## Description {#details}

<p>Help to insert <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/sdnodeflags">SDNodeFlags</a> automatically in transforming.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> RAII to save and resume flags in current scope.</p>
